lines.text: Rain, rain, go away, come again another day!
But when winter temperatures drop below freezing, rain turns into magical snow!
How does invisible vapor floating in fluffy clouds turn into soft white snowflakes?
High in the cold sky, clouds are filled with freezing water vapor and tiny floating dust!
When the temperature dips below thirty-two degrees Fahrenheit, magic happens!
Water vapor skips turning into rain and crystalizes directly into solid ice!
Billions of tiny ice crystals group together into soft, puffy snowflakes!
When they become too heavy for the cloud to hold, they gently float down to Earth!
